tools.name: Medicare_Medicaid_LEIE_generate_states
tools.description: Function to aggregate the Medicare and Medicaid Entity Exclusions by City and State. System examines the most recent Office of Inspector General (OIG) List of Excluded Individuals and Entities (LEIE) which legally excludes an entity from receiving any Federal Medicare or Medicaid funds. System aggregates the information by city and state, and generates a list ordered by prevalence. Example use case: "Which city and state have the most medicare and medicaid entity exclusions?". Original Data can be found here: https://oig.hhs.gov/exclusions/downloadables/UPDATED.csv
